item.description: ## Summary Post Shoppable Photos and Post Shoppable Video APIs now validate whether an attached product only supports auction sales. item.title: Get Opportunity Detail and List Opportunity APIs: New Fields Added
item.description: ## Summary Get Opportunity Detail and List Opportunity APIs add new response fields to provide opportunity tag codes and reference product information. Get Opportunity Detail also adds opportunity tags, while List Opportunity adds information about rewards sellers can receive for listing products as required. List Opportunity also supports filtering opportunities by tag codes through a new optional request field, `tag_codes`. ## What is changing **Get Opportunity Detail — 4 new response fields**...

item.title: Combined Listing: Merge into Variants and API Integration Updates
item.description: Combined Listing now supports **Merge into Variants**, allowing sellers to consolidate same-style products listed under separate links into one main product detail page. New sales and reviews generated through the main listing are aggregated under the main product. Historical sales and reviews are not fully transferred, and orders placed through the original child listings continue to contribute to those child products. [Feature guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=1...

item.title: For GS POP Sellers Shipping to EU Markets: Product Identifier (PID) Attribute Requirement Update
item.description: # What is changing? Starting **November 1, 2026**, product information used for EU customs declaration must include valid **Product Identifier (PID)** information for goods shipped from outside the EU directly to consumers in EU markets. For each applicable product, the platform will provide **M-PID**. Partners must provide at least one merchant-managed identifier through the following product attributes: * **Seller SKU**, which maps to **NS-PID** * **Product Identifier**, which maps to **S-PID*...
